answered.sql: SELECT MedicalDevices.deviceName, Companies.name FROM MedicalDevices JOIN DeviceDevelopment ON MedicalDevices.medicalDeviceId = DeviceDevelopment.medicalDeviceId JOIN Companies ON DeviceDevelopment.companyId = Companies.id
